page.layout: One column of running text, justified, with the running head at the top and the page number at the top right. No marginal notes or footnotes are printed. The left edge is cut, so the first word of the page is a fragment.

main_text.p: omnia vetustate obsita restituit. Xenodochium S. Spiritus ædificiis ampliauit: in quo vitæ suæ ordi-nem depingi gloriofulus curauit. Templum Pacis de novo cōstruxit, impositis canonicis regularibus: templum quoq; S. Mariæ de populo, à fundamen-tis erexit. Imò ecclesias urbis omnes aut instaura-vit, aut beneficia saltem ipsis contulit: & indici ri-tus sacerdotibus fanum[?] fabricauit. Pontem Aureum penitus collapsum, suo apposito nomine, & ædes in Vaticano pontificias refecit, Prætorianisq; excubitoribus loca commoda assignauit. Ad vice-simum quintum annum, iubileum, propinquorum suorum causa, avarus mercator reduxit, primusq; celebrauit. Multa officia scribarum, breviatorum, sollicitatorum, astipulatorum, & Apostolici fisci notariorum, ad marsupium excogitauit: quæ sem-per a pontifice pecunia possent redimi. Conditio-nes fœderis Romanæ sedis & Galliarum regni (ad ecclesiastica spectantes negotia) publicè omnibus exhibuit. Conceptionis Mariæ, ac Præsentationis eiusdem, Annæ eius matris, Iosephi nutritij, Franci-sci Seraphici, & Alberti Drepanensis, festiuita-tes instituit, Bonaventuramq; Franciscanum in sanctos papisticos retulit. Triginta duos Cardinales suo tempore creauit: ac multas ordinationes ad cleri commoditatem edidit. Laurentium Medicem Flo-rentiæ[?]

page.notes: The first word is cut off at the left edge of the scan, so "omnia" is read from its visible letters. "fanum" is read as "fanum" (the printed glyph is uncertain between f and s). "festiuita-" is uncertain; the printed glyphs read as "stiuita". The last word "rentiæ" is cut off at the right edge of the scan; the final æ is not clearly visible. The printed "s" is transcribed as "s" throughout. Spelling "avarus" follows the visible letters "auarus" with u/v normalised.
